initialDossier.tagline: Safety is built, not assumed.
initialDossier.philosophy: White believes peace is not a mood. It is a structure: rules that hold, shelter that lasts, and obligations people can trust under pressure.
initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING White Safety is built, not assumed. White believes peace is not a mood. It is a structure: rules that hold, shelter that lasts, and obligations people can trust under pressure. ART: JOHN STANKO - BUILDER'S BLESSING Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED PROFILE White — Peace through Order White values structure, protection, community, duty, and shared stability. It asks how life can be made safer through order. LORE White does not seek order for its own sake. It builds order because order lets vulnerable people survive chaos, selfishness, and the failures of impulse. CORE TENSION White protects through standards and systems, but its virtue can harden into over-control when safety becomes more important than listening. O Order DEFINING 96 K Knowledge PRESENT 42 A Ambition FAINT 24 F Freedom FAINT 30 G Growth PRESENT 58 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore White is a Commander deck that builds protection into the table state: widen the board, defend the key piece, and let structure turn survival into pressure. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Protective Tokens, Taxes and Rules, Equipment and Guardians. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. COLOR SPELLCRAFT Choose whether protection serves a wide board, a taxed table, or one equipped guardian, then keep enough interaction to preserve that plan. TABLE CAUTION Protect the engine, keep the standards clear, and do not spend your last shield before the table commits its real threat.

initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Black Power is protection when no one is coming to save you. Black believes the world offers no guaranteed fairness. It secures agency by treating life, death, loyalty, and resources as costs that can be paid for control. ART: DONATO GIANCOLA - ALTAR'S REAP Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED PROFILE Black — Power through Opportunity Black claims agency by turning costs, risks, and resources into leverage. Its power is deliberate, consequential, and not cruelty for its own sake. LORE Black does not confuse self-preservation with cruelty. It asks what must be paid, what can be converted, and what leverage keeps its fate from belonging to someone else. CORE TENSION Black protects the self through power and leverage, but its clarity can harden into isolation when every bond becomes a liability. O Order FAINT 30 K Knowledge PRESENT 56 A Ambition DEFINING 98 F Freedom STRONG 62 G Growth PRESENT 42 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Black is a Commander deck that turns cost into agency: spend life, cash in creatures, and make the graveyard or hand become a resource engine before the table can stabilize. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Life Payment Engines, Aristocrats and Sacrifice, Reanimator Control. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. COLOR SPELLCRAFT Choose whether life, sacrificed creatures, or the graveyard is the main fuel source, then keep the recovery line that lets the deck survive its own costs. TABLE CAUTION Hold a sacrifice outlet, spend life deliberately, and rebuild from the graveyard before the engine runs dry.

initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Red The honest spark moves before the cage closes. Red believes feeling is a form of truth. Freedom becomes real when the impulse is allowed to move now, before fear, permission, or overthinking can smother it. ART: CHRISTOPHER MOELLER - CHAIN LIGHTNING Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED PROFILE Red — Freedom through Action Red turns feeling into action before life hardens into regret. Its freedom stays vivid, loyal, and answerable for the sparks it throws. LORE Red does not need cruelty, theater, primal belonging, or technical performance to prove itself. It trusts the present moment, ignites the next action, and lets emotion reveal what matters. CORE TENSION Red protects aliveness through immediacy and freedom, but its virtue can burn out when every delay feels like a cage. O Order FAINT 36 K Knowledge FAINT 34 A Ambition PRESENT 58 F Freedom DEFINING 98 G Growth STRONG 62 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Red is a Commander deck that turns impulse into damage and momentum: commit early, keep mana and cards moving, and let the next spark become direct pressure before the table settles. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Burn and Damage, Haste Aggro, Impulse Draw and Treasures. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. COLOR SPELLCRAFT Choose whether direct damage, hasty attackers, or temporary cards and Treasure create the opening, then plan how the deck reloads after its first burst. TABLE CAUTION Sequence the burst while it matters, remove the piece that changes combat, and keep one reload spell for the turn after the table answers.

initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Green The seed remembers what it is becoming. Green believes the world is not an unsolved machine. It is a living order already holding each creature's place, and strength comes from accepting nature, rooting deeply, and letting time reveal what was always in the seed. ART: ALEKSI BRICLOT - PRIMORDIAL HYDRA Browsing does not change your saved reading. Its growth is patient, purposeful, and wary of mistaking every change for wisdom. LORE Green listens for the old pattern beneath the noise: land, instinct, kinship with living systems, patient growth, and the quiet confidence to become what the world has already made possible. CORE TENSION Green protects flourishing through acceptance and interdependence, but its virtue can harden into stagnation when every necessary change is dismissed as unnatural. O Order STRONG 62 K Knowledge PRESENT 48 A Ambition FAINT 38 F Freedom PRESENT 58 G Growth DEFINING 98 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Azorius Senate Law, procedure, and enforceable structure protect civic order when they stay accountable to the people they govern. Azorius trusts law, information, documentation, and procedure to make civic life legible and protected, while recognizing that process must remain accountable to people. ART: HALLOWED FOUNTAIN Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix Component traces Synthesis IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED SYNTHESIS Azorius — Law through Knowledge Azorius blends White order with Blue planning. It seeks peace through systems, procedure, documentation, and accountable civic structure. LORE Azorius is Ravnica's white-blue civic/legal guild: a lawmaking, law-enforcing, and law-interpreting institution that turns order and procedure into public authority. CORE TENSION Azorius rules can protect society, but its desire for order can become emotionally distant, inaccessible, and slow when procedure turns into an end in itself. O Order DEFINING 82 K Knowledge STRONG 78 A Ambition FAINT 28 F Freedom FAINT 26 G Growth PRESENT 54 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Azorius Senate is a Commander deck that can explore proactive rule-setting with taxes, reactive permission with open mana, or tempo that protects a board while delaying a key opposing play. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Public Rule-Setting, Procedural Permission, Timed Enforcement. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Choose whether public rule-setting, procedural permission, or timed enforcement is the main plan, then decide which effects keep that plan accountable and moving instead of merely extending the game. TABLE CAUTION Identify the interaction window that matters: answer the spell or permanent that changes the game, rather than holding every response or extending the game by default.

initialDossier.philosophy: Boros philosophy joins civic order with urgent protection. Its best expression acts when harm is present, but remains accountable to the public duty it claims to serve.
initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Boros Legion Public protection. Disciplined action. Boros philosophy joins civic order with urgent protection. Its best expression acts when harm is present, but remains accountable to the public duty it claims to serve. ART: ADAM PAQUETTE - SOLAR BLAZE Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix Component traces Synthesis IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED SYNTHESIS Boros — Conviction through Action Boros turns White duty into action through Red conviction. It meets visible threats with disciplined, coordinated force in service of protection—not aggression for its own sake. LORE As Ravnica's peacekeeping and military arm, the Legion spans street-level Wojek investigation, organized patrol, and martial defense. CORE TENSION Boros balances law-enforcement duty, military force, teamwork, and protection. Its danger is treating force as self-justifying after the peacekeeping purpose has fallen away. O Order DEFINING 84 K Knowledge FAINT 38 A Ambition PRESENT 46 F Freedom DEFINING 82 G Growth STRONG 62 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Boros Legion is a Commander deck that turns attacks into clean decisions: build one disciplined combat line, protect it, and use equipment or coordinated pressure to end hesitation. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Battalion Formation, Mentor the Front Line, Equipped Protection. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Choose whether a Battalion formation, a Mentor-led front line, or one equipped protector carries the attack, then reserve protection for the piece that keeps the public duty intact. TABLE CAUTION Sequence attacks carefully, protect your key threat, and remove the blocker that makes the clean strike fail.

initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Golgari Swarm What is discarded can feed the next cycle. Golgari treats death, decay, and discarded matter as useful material inside a living cycle: undercity survival, food production, graveyard resources, and renewal rather than generic morbidity. ART: MARK TEDIN - DARK HEART OF THE WOOD Browsing does not change your saved reading. It sees decay, hunger, grave-soil, renewal, inevitability, and survival as one cycle. LORE Golgari Swarm is the black-green Ravnican guild source-bounded by death-to-life reclamation, decay, undercity survival, food production, and graveyard-resource use. Story-corpus rows remain discovery metadata unless later localized. CORE TENSION Golgari is strongest when reclamation feeds survival and renewal; it weakens when reduced to generic black-green resilience, graveyard aesthetics, or fatalistic rot without a cycle. O Order PRESENT 42 K Knowledge PRESENT 52 A Ambition DEFINING 82 F Freedom PRESENT 58 G Growth DEFINING 82 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Golgari Swarm is a Commander deck that turns death into future value: fill the graveyard, sacrifice expendable bodies, and grind through resource loops until every trade becomes reclamation. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Reclamation Midrange, Graveyard Resource Loops, Undergrowth and Renewal. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Choose whether reclamation midrange, graveyard resource loops, or Undergrowth and renewal converts loss into material, then keep a recovery line for graveyard hate. TABLE CAUTION If graveyard hate appears early, slow down, rebuild through value creatures, and hold your recursion until the table spends its answers.

initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Gruul Clans Wild places lost. The clans answer directly. The Gruul were assigned Ravnica's wild places, then urban expansion and other guilds eroded that role. Their red-green identity centers loose clans, Rubblebelt territory, direct action, riot and bloodrush pressure, and anger at imposed civilization. ART: ADAM PAQUETTE - ZHUR-TAA ANCIENT Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix Component traces Synthesis IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED SYNTHESIS Gruul - Wild Places Answering Back Gruul blends Red directness with Green memory of place. It belongs where anger is tied to lost wilds, clan territory, Rubblebelt life, and resistance to imposed civilization. LORE Gruul identity is not generic red-green aggression. It centers dispossessed wild places, clan autonomy, Rubblebelt belonging, and direct resistance to the city systems that replaced their stewardship. CORE TENSION Gruul is strongest when rage protects territory, memory, clan, or wildness, and weakest when flattened into random rage, generic aggression, or mindless destruction. O Order PRESENT 44 K Knowledge FAINT 38 A Ambition PRESENT 48 F Freedom DEFINING 86 G Growth DEFINING 84 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Gruul Clans is a Commander deck that attacks the table before it can settle: ramp hard, present oversized trampling threats, and make everyone answer creatures on your pace. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Wild Reclamation, Clan-Fed Pressure, Riot Momentum. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Choose whether wild reclamation, clan-fed creature pressure, or Riot momentum carries the attack, then ramp toward the threat that makes imposed pacing impossible. TABLE CAUTION Ramp with a destination, sequence smaller threats first, and protect the one oversized creature that makes blocks impossible.

initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Izzet League Invent first. Stabilize what the experiment teaches. The Izzet League turns blue-red curiosity into elemental magic, mizzium technology, civic engineering, spell engines, and prototypes. Its best work makes discovery useful; its pressure point is volatile experimentation that can outrun care, procedure, or restraint. ART: STEAM VENTS Browsing does not change your saved reading. It favors experiment, inspiration, volatility, invention, and sudden impossible insight. LORE The Izzet tension is invention as public benefit versus invention as obsession: the same guild that builds infrastructure and emergency solutions can also reward speed, spectacle, and risky discovery pressure. CORE TENSION Izzet discovery wants to move fast enough to find the breakthrough while remaining useful enough to repair, rebuild, or stabilize what the experiment affects. O Order FAINT 36 K Knowledge DEFINING 86 A Ambition PRESENT 46 F Freedom DEFINING 82 G Growth PRESENT 54 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Izzet League is a Commander deck that turns velocity into advantage: chain experiments, recur the right spell, and use tempo to make the table answer your storm before it stabilizes. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Prototype Velocity, Jump-Start Iteration, Overload Breakthrough. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Choose whether prototype velocity, Jump-start iteration, or an Overload breakthrough is the experiment, then budget the cards and mana that let a failed test teach the next one. TABLE CAUTION Wait for shields to drop, hold interaction, and protect the engine before you commit the storm turn.

initialDossier.tagline: Debt, deals, and hierarchy made official.
initialDossier.philosophy: Orzhov is the white-black Ravnican guild where religious legitimacy, deal-making business, debt, and cartel hierarchy overlap. Vox Mana reads it through collectible obligation and institutional leverage, not generic WB attrition, lifegain/drain, taxes, sacrifice, recursion, or removal mechanics alone.
initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Orzhov Syndicate Debt, deals, and hierarchy made official. Orzhov is the white-black Ravnican guild where religious legitimacy, deal-making business, debt, and cartel hierarchy overlap. Vox Mana reads it through collectible obligation and institutional leverage, not generic WB attrition, lifegain/drain, taxes, sacrifice, recursion, or removal mechanics alone. ART: GREG STAPLES - GHOST COUNCIL OF ORZHOVA Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix Component traces Synthesis IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED SYNTHESIS Orzhov — Obligation through Power Orzhov blends White structure with Black ambition. It frames duty, debt, hierarchy, devotion, sacrifice, and power as binding systems. LORE The reviewed Orzhov source supports a religious organization whose modern identity emphasizes deals and business, with a cartel hierarchy led by priests or kingpins. Public Orzhov copy should stay bounded to obligation, debt, institutional leverage, named leadership, and afterlife mechanics texture. CORE TENSION Orzhov presents religious and institutional authority while its reviewed guide emphasizes deals, business, debt, organized crime, and cartel leadership as the operating reality. O Order STRONG 78 K Knowledge PRESENT 48 A Ambition STRONG 78 F Freedom PRESENT 42 G Growth PRESENT 50 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Orzhov Syndicate is a Commander deck that makes every exchange a debt: tax resources, drain life, sacrifice small pieces, and make obligation a pressure engine no opponent can ignore. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Obligation Engines, Payment Pressure, Afterlife Accounts. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Choose whether sacrifice records each obligation, taxes make payment unavoidable, or Afterlife tokens keep the account open, then decide how the deck collects without stalling the table. TABLE CAUTION Hold a sacrifice outlet, buy time with drains, and remove the key piece before debts turn into a board wipe.

initialDossier.tagline: Performance makes appetite, cost, and consequence visible.
initialDossier.philosophy: Rakdos turns black-red appetite into public spectacle: performance, provocation, sensation, and visible cost become the way restraint is mocked and hidden pressure is exposed. It is not generic evil or random disruption; the signal is the act, the audience, and the consequence.
initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Cult of Rakdos Performance makes appetite, cost, and consequence visible. Rakdos turns black-red appetite into public spectacle: performance, provocation, sensation, and visible cost become the way restraint is mocked and hidden pressure is exposed. It is not generic evil or random disruption; the signal is the act, the audience, and the consequence. ART: RIX MAADI, DUNGEON PALACE Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix Component traces Synthesis IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED SYNTHESIS Rakdos — Appetite through Expression Rakdos blends Black ambition with Red freedom. It turns desire, spectacle, indulgence, danger, and provocation into identity. LORE The Cult of Rakdos is source-bounded by dangerous entertainment, public performance, loose troupe-like organization, and the demon Rakdos as patron. CORE TENSION Rakdos is strongest when spectacle reveals pressure in public, and weakest when flattened into generic aggression or shock without an act. O Order FAINT 32 K Knowledge PRESENT 48 A Ambition DEFINING 84 F Freedom DEFINING 88 G Growth PRESENT 48 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Cult of Rakdos is a Commander deck that makes entertainment expensive: push damage, cash in reckless advantage, and turn spectacle into a pressure engine the table has to respect. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Spectacle Pressure, Risk for Release, Sacrifice with Consequence. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Damage triggers, sacrifice outlets, impulse draw, menace threats, and chaos payoffs that make opponents pay for every seat in the room. TABLE CAUTION Sequence smaller threats first, make the table spend removal, then turn the damage engine loose.

initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Simic Combine Life studied as an adaptive, improvable system. Simic treats nature as living systems to preserve, heal, study, adapt, and improve through biology, clade practice, and experimentation. ART: SIMIC GUILDGATE Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix Component traces Synthesis IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED SYNTHESIS Simic — Adaptation through Knowledge Simic studies life as living systems to heal, adapt, and improve through biology, clades, and public health. LORE The source-supported Simic center is biological stewardship under pressure: physicians, surgeons, clades, zonots, Adapt, and leadership tension around how far improvement should go. CORE TENSION Simic keeps a connection to nature while pursuing improvement; its risk is radical biological intervention, not generic science, counters, ramp, or nature aesthetics. O Order PRESENT 52 K Knowledge DEFINING 84 A Ambition FAINT 38 F Freedom PRESENT 46 G Growth DEFINING 88 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Simic Combine is a Commander deck that adapts in motion: ramp, evolve through counters, and turn biological upgrades into flash-value pressure that improves whenever the game changes. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Living-System Value, Biological Adaptation, Clade Research and Pressure Response. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Choose whether ramp grows a living-system engine, counters express biological adaptation, or clade research changes the pressure response, then protect the organism that converts each upgrade into value. TABLE CAUTION Protect the engine, draw cards after each upgrade, and rebuild with counters when removal interrupts the experiment.

initialDossier.tagline: Safety is built, not assumed.
initialDossier.philosophy: White believes peace is not a mood. It is a structure: rules that hold, shelter that lasts, and obligations people can trust under pressure.
initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING White Safety is built, not assumed. White believes peace is not a mood. It is a structure: rules that hold, shelter that lasts, and obligations people can trust under pressure. ART: JOHN STANKO - BUILDER'S BLESSING Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED PROFILE White — Peace through Order White values structure, protection, community, duty, and shared stability. It asks how life can be made safer through order. LORE White does not seek order for its own sake. It builds order because order lets vulnerable people survive chaos, selfishness, and the failures of impulse. CORE TENSION White protects through standards and systems, but its virtue can harden into over-control when safety becomes more important than listening. initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Blue Possibility opens when the pattern is understood. Blue believes no one is finished by default. Knowledge, practice, and precise systems let people and worlds become more than their starting shape. ART: ZOLTAN BOROS & GABOR SZIKSZAI - ACADEMY RUINS Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED PROFILE Blue — Perfection through Knowledge Blue values learning, patience, improvement, planning, and possibility. It asks what life could become with enough understanding. LORE Blue does not act from impulse. It studies the variables, preserves options, and reshapes the future once the hidden structure is clear. CORE TENSION Blue protects possibility through understanding, but its virtue can harden into paralysis when perfect information matters more than timely action. O Order FAINT 38 K Knowledge DEFINING 98 A Ambition FAINT 36 F Freedom FAINT 34 G Growth PRESENT 54 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Blue is a Commander deck that turns knowledge into control: draw cards, preserve options, answer key spells, and let information become inevitability. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Draw-Go Control, Spellslinger Tokens, Artifacts and Clones. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. COLOR SPELLCRAFT Choose whether to hold up Draw-Go Control, turn spells into token pressure, or build around artifacts and copied effects, then decide how much mana must stay available each turn. TABLE CAUTION Hold mana for the important spell, draw before committing, and keep one clean answer for the table's real threat.

initialDossier.tagline: Power is protection when no one is coming to save you.
initialDossier.philosophy: Black believes the world offers no guaranteed fairness. It secures agency by treating life, death, loyalty, and resources as costs that can be paid for control.
initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Black Power is protection when no one is coming to save you. Black believes the world offers no guaranteed fairness. It secures agency by treating life, death, loyalty, and resources as costs that can be paid for control. ART: DONATO GIANCOLA - ALTAR'S REAP Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED PROFILE Black — Power through Opportunity Black claims agency by turning costs, risks, and resources into leverage. Its power is deliberate, consequential, and not cruelty for its own sake. LORE Black does not confuse self-preservation with cruelty. It asks what must be paid, what can be converted, and what leverage keeps its fate from belonging to someone else. CORE TENSION Black protects the self through power and leverage, but its clarity can harden into isolation when every bond becomes a liability. O Order FAINT 30 K Knowledge PRESENT 56 A Ambition DEFINING 98 F Freedom STRONG 62 G Growth PRESENT 42 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Black is a Commander deck that turns cost into agency: spend life, cash in creatures, and make the graveyard or hand become a resource engine before the table can stabilize. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Life Payment Engines, Aristocrats and Sacrifice, Reanimator Control. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. COLOR SPELLCRAFT Choose whether life, sacrificed creatures, or the graveyard is the main fuel source, then keep the recovery line that lets the deck survive its own costs. TABLE CAUTION Hold a sacrifice outlet, spend life deliberately, and rebuild from the graveyard before the engine runs dry.

Its freedom stays vivid, loyal, and answerable for the sparks it throws. LORE Red does not need cruelty, theater, primal belonging, or technical performance to prove itself. It trusts the present moment, ignites the next action, and lets emotion reveal what matters. CORE TENSION Red protects aliveness through immediacy and freedom, but its virtue can burn out when every delay feels like a cage. O Order FAINT 36 K Knowledge FAINT 34 A Ambition PRESENT 58 F Freedom DEFINING 98 G Growth STRONG 62 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Red is a Commander deck that turns impulse into damage and momentum: commit early, keep mana and cards moving, and let the next spark become direct pressure before the table settles. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Burn and Damage, Haste Aggro, Impulse Draw and Treasures. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. COLOR SPELLCRAFT Choose whether direct damage, hasty attackers, or temporary cards and Treasure create the opening, then plan how the deck reloads after its first burst. TABLE CAUTION Sequence the burst while it matters, remove the piece that changes combat, and keep one reload spell for the turn after the table answers.

initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Green The seed remembers what it is becoming. Green believes the world is not an unsolved machine. It is a living order already holding each creature's place, and strength comes from accepting nature, rooting deeply, and letting time reveal what was always in the seed. ART: ALEKSI BRICLOT - PRIMORDIAL HYDRA Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED PROFILE Green — Growth through Acceptance Green accepts a role within the web of life and lets inherent nature unfold. Its growth is patient, purposeful, and wary of mistaking every change for wisdom. LORE Green listens for the old pattern beneath the noise: land, instinct, kinship with living systems, patient growth, and the quiet confidence to become what the world has already made possible. CORE TENSION Green protects flourishing through acceptance and interdependence, but its virtue can harden into stagnation when every necessary change is dismissed as unnatural. O Order STRONG 62 K Knowledge PRESENT 48 A Ambition FAINT 38 F Freedom PRESENT 58 G Growth DEFINING 98 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Green is a Commander deck that turns patience into natural scale: develop lands, keep the creature engine alive, and let organic growth become too large for the table to ignore. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Ramp and Big Mana, Apex Creatures, Landfall and Creature Value. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. COLOR SPELLCRAFT Choose whether lands, apex creatures, or creature-and-land value is the main growth engine, then protect the piece that turns development into scale. TABLE CAUTION Develop mana first, protect the living engine, and commit the largest creature after the table spends its clean answer.

initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Azorius Senate Law, procedure, and enforceable structure protect civic order when they stay accountable to the people they govern. Azorius trusts law, information, documentation, and procedure to make civic life legible and protected, while recognizing that process must remain accountable to people. ART: HALLOWED FOUNTAIN Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix Component traces Synthesis IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED SYNTHESIS Azorius — Law through Knowledge Azorius blends White order with Blue planning. It seeks peace through systems, procedure, documentation, and accountable civic structure. LORE Azorius is Ravnica's white-blue civic/legal guild: a lawmaking, law-enforcing, and law-interpreting institution that turns order and procedure into public authority. CORE TENSION Azorius rules can protect society, but its desire for order can become emotionally distant, inaccessible, and slow when procedure turns into an end in itself. O Order DEFINING 82 K Knowledge STRONG 78 A Ambition FAINT 28 F Freedom FAINT 26 G Growth PRESENT 54 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Azorius Senate is a Commander deck that can explore proactive rule-setting with taxes, reactive permission with open mana, or tempo that protects a board while delaying a key opposing play. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Public Rule-Setting, Procedural Permission, Timed Enforcement. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Choose whether public rule-setting, procedural permission, or timed enforcement is the main plan, then decide which effects keep that plan accountable and moving instead of merely extending the game. TABLE CAUTION Identify the interaction window that matters: answer the spell or permanent that changes the game, rather than holding every response or extending the game by default.

It meets visible threats with disciplined, coordinated force in service of protection—not aggression for its own sake. LORE As Ravnica's peacekeeping and military arm, the Legion spans street-level Wojek investigation, organized patrol, and martial defense. CORE TENSION Boros balances law-enforcement duty, military force, teamwork, and protection. Its danger is treating force as self-justifying after the peacekeeping purpose has fallen away. initialDossier.philosophy: Golgari treats death, decay, and discarded matter as useful material inside a living cycle: undercity survival, food production, graveyard resources, and renewal rather than generic morbidity.
initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Golgari Swarm What is discarded can feed the next cycle. Golgari treats death, decay, and discarded matter as useful material inside a living cycle: undercity survival, food production, graveyard resources, and renewal rather than generic morbidity. ART: MARK TEDIN - DARK HEART OF THE WOOD Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix Component traces Synthesis IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED SYNTHESIS Golgari — Survival through Recursion Golgari blends Black ambition with Green growth. It sees decay, hunger, grave-soil, renewal, inevitability, and survival as one cycle. LORE Golgari Swarm is the black-green Ravnican guild source-bounded by death-to-life reclamation, decay, undercity survival, food production, and graveyard-resource use. Story-corpus rows remain discovery metadata unless later localized. CORE TENSION Golgari is strongest when reclamation feeds survival and renewal; it weakens when reduced to generic black-green resilience, graveyard aesthetics, or fatalistic rot without a cycle. O Order PRESENT 42 K Knowledge PRESENT 52 A Ambition DEFINING 82 F Freedom PRESENT 58 G Growth DEFINING 82 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Golgari Swarm is a Commander deck that turns death into future value: fill the graveyard, sacrifice expendable bodies, and grind through resource loops until every trade becomes reclamation. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Reclamation Midrange, Graveyard Resource Loops, Undergrowth and Renewal. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Choose whether reclamation midrange, graveyard resource loops, or Undergrowth and renewal converts loss into material, then keep a recovery line for graveyard hate. TABLE CAUTION If graveyard hate appears early, slow down, rebuild through value creatures, and hold your recursion until the table spends its answers.

initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Gruul Clans Wild places lost. The clans answer directly. The Gruul were assigned Ravnica's wild places, then urban expansion and other guilds eroded that role. Their red-green identity centers loose clans, Rubblebelt territory, direct action, riot and bloodrush pressure, and anger at imposed civilization. ART: ADAM PAQUETTE - ZHUR-TAA ANCIENT Browsing does not change your saved reading. It belongs where anger is tied to lost wilds, clan territory, Rubblebelt life, and resistance to imposed civilization. LORE Gruul identity is not generic red-green aggression. It centers dispossessed wild places, clan autonomy, Rubblebelt belonging, and direct resistance to the city systems that replaced their stewardship. CORE TENSION Gruul is strongest when rage protects territory, memory, clan, or wildness, and weakest when flattened into random rage, generic aggression, or mindless destruction. O Order PRESENT 44 K Knowledge FAINT 38 A Ambition PRESENT 48 F Freedom DEFINING 86 G Growth DEFINING 84 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Wild Reclamation, Clan-Fed Pressure, Riot Momentum. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Choose whether wild reclamation, clan-fed creature pressure, or Riot momentum carries the attack, then ramp toward the threat that makes imposed pacing impossible. TABLE CAUTION Ramp with a destination, sequence smaller threats first, and protect the one oversized creature that makes blocks impossible.

initialDossier.tagline: Invent first. Stabilize what the experiment teaches.
initialDossier.philosophy: The Izzet League turns blue-red curiosity into elemental magic, mizzium technology, civic engineering, spell engines, and prototypes. Its best work makes discovery useful; its pressure point is volatile experimentation that can outrun care, procedure, or restraint.
initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Izzet League Invent first. Stabilize what the experiment teaches. The Izzet League turns blue-red curiosity into elemental magic, mizzium technology, civic engineering, spell engines, and prototypes. Its best work makes discovery useful; its pressure point is volatile experimentation that can outrun care, procedure, or restraint. ART: STEAM VENTS Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix Component traces Synthesis IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED SYNTHESIS Izzet — Discovery through Impulse Izzet blends Blue knowledge with Red freedom. It favors experiment, inspiration, volatility, invention, and sudden impossible insight. LORE The Izzet tension is invention as public benefit versus invention as obsession: the same guild that builds infrastructure and emergency solutions can also reward speed, spectacle, and risky discovery pressure. CORE TENSION Izzet discovery wants to move fast enough to find the breakthrough while remaining useful enough to repair, rebuild, or stabilize what the experiment affects. O Order FAINT 36 K Knowledge DEFINING 86 A Ambition PRESENT 46 F Freedom DEFINING 82 G Growth PRESENT 54 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Izzet League is a Commander deck that turns velocity into advantage: chain experiments, recur the right spell, and use tempo to make the table answer your storm before it stabilizes. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Prototype Velocity, Jump-Start Iteration, Overload Breakthrough. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Choose whether prototype velocity, Jump-start iteration, or an Overload breakthrough is the experiment, then budget the cards and mana that let a failed test teach the next one. TABLE CAUTION Wait for shields to drop, hold interaction, and protect the engine before you commit the storm turn.

initialDossier.philosophy: Orzhov is the white-black Ravnican guild where religious legitimacy, deal-making business, debt, and cartel hierarchy overlap. Vox Mana reads it through collectible obligation and institutional leverage, not generic WB attrition, lifegain/drain, taxes, sacrifice, recursion, or removal mechanics alone.
initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Orzhov Syndicate Debt, deals, and hierarchy made official. Orzhov is the white-black Ravnican guild where religious legitimacy, deal-making business, debt, and cartel hierarchy overlap. Vox Mana reads it through collectible obligation and institutional leverage, not generic WB attrition, lifegain/drain, taxes, sacrifice, recursion, or removal mechanics alone. ART: GREG STAPLES - GHOST COUNCIL OF ORZHOVA Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix Component traces Synthesis IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED SYNTHESIS Orzhov — Obligation through Power Orzhov blends White structure with Black ambition. It frames duty, debt, hierarchy, devotion, sacrifice, and power as binding systems. LORE The reviewed Orzhov source supports a religious organization whose modern identity emphasizes deals and business, with a cartel hierarchy led by priests or kingpins. Public Orzhov copy should stay bounded to obligation, debt, institutional leverage, named leadership, and afterlife mechanics texture. CORE TENSION Orzhov presents religious and institutional authority while its reviewed guide emphasizes deals, business, debt, organized crime, and cartel leadership as the operating reality. O Order STRONG 78 K Knowledge PRESENT 48 A Ambition STRONG 78 F Freedom PRESENT 42 G Growth PRESENT 50 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Orzhov Syndicate is a Commander deck that makes every exchange a debt: tax resources, drain life, sacrifice small pieces, and make obligation a pressure engine no opponent can ignore. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Obligation Engines, Payment Pressure, Afterlife Accounts. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Choose whether sacrifice records each obligation, taxes make payment unavoidable, or Afterlife tokens keep the account open, then decide how the deck collects without stalling the table. TABLE CAUTION Hold a sacrifice outlet, buy time with drains, and remove the key piece before debts turn into a board wipe.

initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Cult of Rakdos Performance makes appetite, cost, and consequence visible. Rakdos turns black-red appetite into public spectacle: performance, provocation, sensation, and visible cost become the way restraint is mocked and hidden pressure is exposed. It is not generic evil or random disruption; the signal is the act, the audience, and the consequence. ART: RIX MAADI, DUNGEON PALACE Browsing does not change your saved reading. It turns desire, spectacle, indulgence, danger, and provocation into identity. LORE The Cult of Rakdos is source-bounded by dangerous entertainment, public performance, loose troupe-like organization, and the demon Rakdos as patron. CORE TENSION Rakdos is strongest when spectacle reveals pressure in public, and weakest when flattened into generic aggression or shock without an act. O Order FAINT 32 K Knowledge PRESENT 48 A Ambition DEFINING 84 F Freedom DEFINING 88 G Growth PRESENT 48 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Cult of Rakdos is a Commander deck that makes entertainment expensive: push damage, cash in reckless advantage, and turn spectacle into a pressure engine the table has to respect. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Spectacle Pressure, Risk for Release, Sacrifice with Consequence. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Damage triggers, sacrifice outlets, impulse draw, menace threats, and chaos payoffs that make opponents pay for every seat in the room. TABLE CAUTION Sequence smaller threats first, make the table spend removal, then turn the damage engine loose.

Belonging becomes sacred when individual voice joins a greater living community. ART: TEMPLE GARDEN Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix Component traces Synthesis IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED SYNTHESIS Selesnya — Harmony through Belonging Selesnya blends Green growth with White order. It seeks harmony, stewardship, collective purpose, shared life, and belonging. LORE Selesnya is the white-green Ravnican guild of communal voice, nature, unity, togetherness, and preservation. CORE TENSION Selesnya offers harmony, care, and shared purpose while asking individual voice to yield to the communal one. O Order DEFINING 86 K Knowledge PRESENT 44 A Ambition FAINT 30 F Freedom PRESENT 42 G Growth DEFINING 84 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Selesnya Conclave is a Commander deck that builds safety through numbers: make tokens, grow the board together, and turn collective strength into attacks that survive one-for-one answers. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Convoke Community, Go-Wide Caretaking, Harmony and Preservation. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Choose whether creatures pay for Convoke, a protected wide board carries communal care, or preservation keeps the community intact, then plan how the group rebuilds after a sweep. TABLE CAUTION Protect the engine, rebuild after wipes, and keep drawing cards so the table cannot answer every token wave.

Azorius trusts law, information, documentation, and procedure to make civic life legible and protected, while recognizing that process must remain accountable to people. It seeks peace through systems, procedure, documentation, and accountable civic structure. LORE Azorius is Ravnica's white-blue civic/legal guild: a lawmaking, law-enforcing, and law-interpreting institution that turns order and procedure into public authority. CORE TENSION Azorius rules can protect society, but its desire for order can become emotionally distant, inaccessible, and slow when procedure turns into an end in itself. O Order DEFINING 82 K Knowledge STRONG 78 A Ambition FAINT 28 F Freedom FAINT 26 G Growth PRESENT 54 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Azorius Senate is a Commander deck that can explore proactive rule-setting with taxes, reactive permission with open mana, or tempo that protects a board while delaying a key opposing play. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Public Rule-Setting, Procedural Permission, Timed Enforcement. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. GUILD SPELLCRAFT Choose whether public rule-setting, procedural permission, or timed enforcement is the main plan, then decide which effects keep that plan accountable and moving instead of merely extending the game. TABLE CAUTION Identify the interaction window that matters: answer the spell or permanent that changes the game, rather than holding every response or extending the game by default.

initialDossier.tagline: Leave no stone unturned.
initialDossier.philosophy: Lorehold treats history as something to recover, question, and put to use. Its scholars pore over artifacts and ancient texts, summon spirits as witnesses, and investigate what surviving records leave behind. White looks for preservation, precedent, and order; Red follows discovery, experience, and messy truths that refuse to stay neatly cataloged.
initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Lorehold College Leave no stone unturned. Lorehold treats history as something to recover, question, and put to use. Its scholars pore over artifacts and ancient texts, summon spirits as witnesses, and investigate what surviving records leave behind. White looks for preservation, precedent, and order; Red follows discovery, experience, and messy truths that refuse to stay neatly cataloged. ART: RAYMOND SWANLAND - VELOMACHUS LOREHOLD Browsing does not change your saved reading. ALL IDENTITIES RETURN TO YOUR SAVED READING DOSSIER DIRECTORY Start Here Identity & Play Commander Browsing Starts Card Signals Mana Notes Maze Discovery VIEW ALL Mana Alignment Matrix Component traces Synthesis IDENTITY PROFILE SELECTED SYNTHESIS Lorehold — History through Action Lorehold overlays Red freedom and White order through history, artifacts, memory, rhetoric, spirits, and action through legacy. LORE Lorehold is Strixhaven's College of Archaeomancy: red-white history magic expressed through artifacts, ancient tomes, spirits, scrolls, field expeditions, and the tension between orderly preservation and chaotic discovery. CORE TENSION Does history belong to order or to chaos? To careful systematic analysis or dangerous fieldwork? The college needs both traditions. Every student must choose - and then watch the choice shape everything afterward. O Order STRONG 78 K Knowledge PRESENT 48 A Ambition PRESENT 42 F Freedom DEFINING 82 G Growth STRONG 64 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Lorehold College is a Commander deck that starts with a historical angle, then lets the commander decide whether spirits, rebuilt relics, spells, or combat carry the lesson into play. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Spirit Witnesses / Graveyard-Leaves, Relic Reconstruction, History & Spells. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. COLLEGE SPELLCRAFT Original Strixhaven supports cards leaving graveyards and Spirit tokens; Osgir owns artifact reconstruction; spells and combat belong only where a chosen commander supports them. TABLE CAUTION Choose one commander-led engine instead of treating every artifact, Spirit, or graveyard card as the same Lorehold package.

Feed the hunger. Bear the consequence. Jund trusts feeling as the first signal: Red moves from self-truth, Black protects appetite and need, and Green turns instinct into force under real consequence. LORE Jund is Alara's Red-centered black-red-green shard expression. Vox Mana reads it through source-bound self-truth, gut instinct, appetite, freedom with consequences, and the absence of White and Blue pressures, not as generic violence, devour, or Modern Jund by another name. CORE TENSION Jund's virtue is honest instinct in motion, but the same pressure can turn appetite into overconsumption or mistake impulse for truth. Keep the line moving. Dune believes presence should claim ground before detached contemplation can cool the moment. White holds the line, Black authorizes the cost, Red keeps ignition immediate, and Green keeps bodies and pressure multiplying. LORE Dune / Aggression is Vox Mana's four-color without Blue expression for organized territorial pressure, direct action, common-front force, and survival-minded multiplication without Blue-style distance. CORE TENSION Dune claims ground through coordinated force before detached contemplation can cool the moment, but common-front pressure can become domination when every body, cost, and opening is treated as something to spend forward. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. TABLE CAUTION Keep the line moving, but do not mistake every combat shell, token deck, or same-color pile for Dune unless the full non-Blue territorial frame and force-backed solidarity are both present.

initialDossier.dossierText: IDENTITY DOSSIER - BROWSING Five-Color All five colors are available. What brings them together depends on the deck. Five-Color gives access to White, Blue, Black, Red, and Green. It does not establish one unified philosophy by itself; the commander, tribe, mechanic, theme, toolbox, or deck plan determines why all five colors are present. ART: ROB ALEXANDER - CHANNEL THE SUNS Browsing does not change your saved reading. All five colors are available. The commander, tribe, mechanic, theme, toolbox, or other deck plan determines why they are together. LORE Five-Color brings all five colors into one Commander plan: breadth, coalition, synthesis, and the responsibility to make every included tool earn its place. CORE TENSION Broader color access increases mana requirements and consistency pressure, while the reason for using that access remains deck-specific. O Order PRESENT 52 K Knowledge PRESENT 56 A Ambition PRESENT 51 F Freedom PRESENT 56 G Growth STRONG 63 See how this identity is expressed across Order, Knowledge, Ambition, Freedom, and Growth. Start Here Use these Commander starting points to turn this identity into decks, cards, and searches you can compare. Start With This Commander Plan One way to explore Five-Color is a Commander deck that chooses one clear job for all-five access—an engine, tribe, tool suite, or payoff—then tunes the mana base around that job. Adjust the budget, complexity, and table role to fit your deck. POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS Explore Fixing & Ramp, Rainbow Payoffs, Full-Spectrum Integrator, Five-Color Toolbox. Compare these lanes to see which one matches the deck you want to build. WHY THESE APPEAR These directions connect the five-color Commander guidance with the themes shown in this dossier. Choose only the lanes that fit the deck you want to explore. FIVE-COLOR SPELLCRAFT Build the mana base around the color demands actually in your list. WUBRG costs and activations need reliable access; sunburst and converge reward it; Domain can benefit without requiring it. Treat fixing as the color system and ramp as extra resources once that system works. TABLE CAUTION Prioritize reliable color sources before optional ramp, then sequence the deck around the engine, tribe, payoff, or answers you chose.
